_comment: Frozen, verified winner/runner-up record for completed seasons. 2016/17-2021/22 manually verified against archived league standings (no live API access to the old league object). 2022/23-2025/26 captured from the last known-good generated site before the league was recreated on 2026-07-23, then verified against each manager's official FPL entry history. 2018/19 rank for Matteo Ebejer was corrected from 46860 (a transcription of his 2019/20 rank) to the true value 56628, confirmed via https://fantasy.premierleague.com/api/entry/184140/history/ on 2026-08-20. 2022/23 winner was corrected from Kylie Schembri to Andre Galea on 2026-08-20 -- Kylie was not actually in the league that season (confirmed by the league admin from memory); Andre Galea (2,573 pts) and Matteo Ebejer (2,569 pts) were the real 1st/2nd once she's excluded. See history_seed.json for the corresponding removal of Kylie's phantom 2022/23 season from her own record. New seasons from 2026/27 onward are appended live from league #37785, not edited here.
